ns2:course.label: Geomorphology
ns2:course.description: History, origin, and characteristics of land forms produced by weathering, fluvial, glacial, wind, and wave processes or by a combination of these acting upon the major kinds of geologic materials and structures. Lectures, laboratory, and field trips. Field trip fee required. Same as ESES 411. Prerequisite: GEOL 208 or consent of instructor.
